coupon_book.name: Coupon Book
coupon_book.d: Shops on the run are 15% cheaper.

running_shoes.name: Running Shoes
running_shoes.d: Your Billies start each battle with their Speed up.

trail_snacks.name: Trail Snacks
trail_snacks.d: Each place you walk into heals your team by 15% of their HP.

lost_property.name: Lost Property Form
lost_property.d: If the run is lost, the payout counts your items at their full price.

petri_dish.name: Petri Dish
petri_dish.d: Spliced wild Billies you knock out pay 50% more DNA.

gene_lure.name: Gene Lure
gene_lure.d: Wild Billies of the places you reach next are spliced twice as often.

stabilizer_gel.name: Stabilizer Gel
stabilizer_gel.d: Your Unstable Billies lose half as much HP at each turn’s end.

rubber_stamp.name: Rubber Stamp
rubber_stamp.d: The first hit your team lands in each battle deals 50% more damage.

click_pen.name: Click Pen
click_pen.d: Every 8th attack your team makes is a critical hit.
click_pen.say: Click! {name} lines up a critical hit.

laser_pointer.name: Laser Pointer
laser_pointer.d: Your Billies land critical hits more often.

screen_protector.name: Screen Protector
screen_protector.d: Each of your Billies takes half damage from the first hit it takes in a battle.

power_bank.name: Power Bank
power_bank.d: Once a battle, a Billie of yours that ends a turn below a quarter of its HP heals 25% of it.

mic_drop.name: Mic Drop
mic_drop.d: When one of your Billies knocks a foe out, its Attack and Sp. Atk rise.

joy_buzzer.name: Joy Buzzer
joy_buzzer.d: Your physical hits have a 15% chance to paralyze.

hot_sauce.name: Hot Sauce
hot_sauce.d: Your special hits have a 10% chance to burn.

hazmat_suit.name: Hazmat Suit
hazmat_suit.d: Sandstorm and sharp stones don’t hurt your Billies, and burns hurt them half as much.

alarm_clock.name: Alarm Clock
alarm_clock.d: Your Billies move first on a battle’s first turn.

plot_armor.name: Plot Armor
plot_armor.d: Your last Billie standing takes 30% less damage and hits 30% harder.

warranty_card.name: Warranty Card
warranty_card.d: Once a run, when your whole team faints, they all get back up with half their HP. Then the card is void.

bellows.name: Bellows
bellows.d: Your Fire Billies’ Kindling builds twice as fast.

snorkel.name: Snorkel
snorkel.d: Your Water Billies’ Undertow kicks in from half their HP.

watering_can.name: Watering Can
watering_can.d: Your Grass Billies’ Regrowth heals twice as much.

static_socks.name: Static Socks
static_socks.d: Your Electric Billies’ Live Wire lands critical hits twice as often.

knee_pads.name: Knee Pads
knee_pads.d: Your Ground Billies’ Bedrock works twice a battle, and from 75% of their HP.

kite.name: Kite
kite.d: Your Flying Billies’ Slipstream works on every switch, not just the first.

mood_ring.name: Mood Ring
mood_ring.d: Your Psychic Billies’ Wild Mind rolls twice and keeps the better.

union_card.name: Union Card
union_card.d: Your Steel Billies’ Alloy counts every teammate on their feet, not only Steel ones.

heirloom_locket.name: Heirloom Locket
heirloom_locket.d: Your Dragon Billies’ Parting Roar raises the next one’s Speed too.

matching_hoodies.name: Matching Hoodies
matching_hoodies.d: If all your Billies share a type, they take 15% less damage.

rainbow_lanyard.name: Rainbow Lanyard
rainbow_lanyard.d: Your Billies hit 3% harder for each different type on your team.

group_chat.name: Group Chat
group_chat.d: Your Billies on the bench get the full XP from each foe, not half.

umbrella.name: Umbrella
umbrella.d: Weather never weakens your Billies’ moves.

snow_globe.name: Snow Globe
snow_globe.d: Your Billies get the weather’s boosts twice over.

barometer.name: Barometer
barometer.d: The forecast shows 3 more days, and walking into a place in rain or a storm heals your team 10%.

bug_net.name: Bug Net
bug_net.d: Billies of a species not on your team are 25% easier to catch.

music_box.name: Music Box
music_box.d: Wild Billies fall asleep as a battle starts 20% of the time.

name_tags.name: Name Tags
name_tags.d: Billies you catch join two levels higher.

pyramid_pouch.name: Pyramid Pouch
pyramid_pouch.d: The first pyramid that misses in each battle comes back.

tip_jar.name: Tip Jar
tip_jar.d: Each place you walk into adds 1 Money for every 10 you carry, up to 40.

punch_card.name: Punch Card
punch_card.d: Every 4th thing you buy in a run shop is free.

gift_receipt.name: Gift Receipt
gift_receipt.d: Reward picks show one more card.

fortune_cookie.name: Fortune Cookie
fortune_cookie.d: The first reroll at every reward pick is free.

tour_brochure.name: Tour Brochure
tour_brochure.d: The run map shows what every place is.

bounty_poster.name: Bounty Poster
bounty_poster.d: Leaders and the rival pay double Moneys.

string_magnet.name: Magnet on a String
string_magnet.d: Beaten bots leave twice the salvage.

lab_goggles.name: Lab Goggles
lab_goggles.d: Spliced wild Billies are 25% easier to catch.

photocopier.name: Photocopier
photocopier.d: Copies the Perk just above it in your Perks list.

like_button.name: Like Button
like_button.d: Your Billies hit 1% harder for every battle won this run, up to 25%.

streak_tracker.name: Streak Tracker
streak_tracker.d: Each battle in a row won without one of yours fainting: your Billies hit 5% harder, up to 25%. A faint starts it over.

selfie_stick.name: Selfie Stick
selfie_stick.d: Catching a Billie heals your team 10%.

coil_of_rope.name: Coil of Rope
coil_of_rope.d: A side area's way opens with its badge alone: no Billie of its type needed.

ten_foot_pole.name: Ten-Foot Pole
ten_foot_pole.d: Event choices never cost your team HP.

rusty_key.name: Rusty Key
rusty_key.d: Side areas hold one more find.

time_card.name: Time Card
time_card.d: Every 5th place you walk into is a day off: your team heals fully.

boarding_pass.name: Boarding Pass
boarding_pass.d: Take it: 150 Moneys and 2 Potions at once. Then it's a souvenir.

travel_pillow.name: Travel Pillow
travel_pillow.d: Walking into a town heals your team 25%.

correction_fluid.name: Correction Fluid
correction_fluid.d: Curses last one place less, and the first curse you’re handed this run is erased at once.

terms_conditions.name: Terms and Conditions
terms_conditions.d: Your Billies hit 30% harder. In exchange, run shops and clinics charge 50% more.

energy_drink.name: Energy Drink
energy_drink.d: Your Billies take the field with their Speed up two stages, but they take 15% more damage.

glass_trophy.name: Glass Trophy
glass_trophy.d: Your Billies deal 50% more damage, and take 30% more.

overclock_chip.name: Overclock Chip
overclock_chip.d: Your Billies hit 35% harder, but every attack that lands costs its user 8% of its HP.

ethics_waiver.name: Ethics Waiver
ethics_waiver.d: Spliced wild Billies turn up three times as often and leave twice the DNA. Clinics charge double.

hustle_planner.name: Hustle Planner
hustle_planner.d: Wins pay twice the Moneys. Your Billies get only a quarter of the XP.

influencer_contract.name: Influencer Contract
influencer_contract.d: Trainers pay three times the Moneys, but a battle in which one of your Billies faints pays nothing.

nonrefundable_ticket.name: Non-Refundable Ticket
nonrefundable_ticket.d: Hold 8 Perks instead of 6. You can never let one go.

early_access.name: Early Access Pass
early_access.d: The run map shows what every place is. Foes are 3 levels higher.

subscription_box.name: Subscription Box
subscription_box.d: Every place you walk into brings a random item, and charges you 15 Moneys.

heavy_crown.name: Heavy Crown
heavy_crown.d: Your lead Billie hits 40% harder and takes 20% less damage. Your other Billies hit 15% less hard.

paid_promotion.name: Paid Promotion
paid_promotion.d: Run shops are 40% off. The boss has 30% more HP.
